candidates.title: Hardware-Software Co-design for 3D-DRAM-based LLM Serving Accelerator
candidates.reason: Systems/hardware-software co-design for dynamic LLM serving on near-memory processing. It includes spatially aware KV allocation, distributed tiled attention, inter-PE communication primitives, and quantitative GPU/NMP comparisons, making it relevant to hierarchical memory and inference-system architecture.

discovery_stats.axis: near-memory processing / 3D DRAM / KV allocation co-design
discovery_stats.query_summary: Shifted from CUDA virtual-memory reclamation to adjacent memory-system hardware/software co-design. Existing SuperInfer and vAttention were treated as known/high-overlap; Helios arXiv:2603.04797 was not found by repository code search and has concrete system mechanisms and evaluation.
discovery_stats.next_axis_hint: Search CXL/NMP/PIM memory-side execution and memory pooling papers, then switch to network/KV-transfer scheduling if overlap rises.
